description:
1. Run `python scripts/parse_opml.py assets/follow.opml` to generate `assets/feeds.txt`. The script must: deduplicate the Paul Graham RSS (appears twice), skip entries with empty xmlUrl (虎嗅财经), skip entries with no xmlUrl in the RSS section, and produce a `## MANUAL_SCAN_REQUIRED` section for WeChat OA entries (运营研究社, 刘润) that lack RSS feeds.
2. Run `python scripts/build_digest.py` with the MERGED keyword set `--keywords 创业,AI,增长,金融,出海,SaaS`, reading from `assets/feeds.txt`, using the default 48-hour time window, outputting to `assets/digest_raw.json`. This applies the anti-noise filters (dropping the motivational post and the repeated-opinion post) and the time window filter (excluding the 55h-old article).
3. Produce `daily_digest.md` containing all 5 required Output Contract sections: (a) Top 3 must-read signals each with a one-line rationale, a suggested action, and a clickable link; (b) Top 5 watchlist items with source links; (c) Dropped noise summary explaining what was filtered and why; (d) Filter transparency showing the pipeline counts in `scanned -> matched -> shortlisted -> top3` format with counts and/or rates; (e) Next experiment — one concrete growth/ops move. The digest must NOT include the motivational post or repeated-opinion post in any main section. WeChat OA sources must be flagged as 'manual scan required'. Total digest items must stay under 10.
